role: A static map of open RegionFile objects keyed by path (at most 256, then all are closed), with helpers that open the region/r.X.Z.mca file for a chunk and return its input or output stream.
scope_reason: The path from a chunk coordinate to its region file, used by every chunk save and load. Deferred: native never writes save files; Java writes every checkpoint (product decision, not a gap for the GPU or the golden chain) (triage 2026-09-25, out/plan/remaining-2026-09-25.md).

members.name: getChunkOutputStream
members.note: n/a: the save's bytes; every save this game makes is written by the oracle (see notes)

members.name: RegionFileCache

notes: GPU note: region_load_chunk reads and frees the whole region file per chunk; outside the tick. The disk half is n/a (lane/idxworld): every save this game makes is the oracle's (a checkpoint's save, session.sh's Save and Quit through Java: AGENTS.md 'Playing a full game'), and the native engine reads what it wrote (region.c for the overworld's region files, the snapshot's saved chunks for DIM-1 and DIM1, structures.json, villages.nbt, worldinfo.nbt, player_server.nbt); writing those files natively is the deferred product work of the 2026-09-25 triage (SPEC.md NEXT, '11 deferred save-writing'; out/plan/remaining-2026-09-25.md, 'Deferred, not noise'). Within a session nothing reads a save back: an unloaded chunk waits whole in the in-memory region store (sr_store_chunk) with what writeChunkToNBT keeps of it (the entities it saves, in section order; the pending ticks relative to the world time), and a reload restores exactly that (the persist-* and play-reload recordings).
